question: Find out how many actors have a 'Shahrukh number' of 2? This means they acted in a film with someone who acted with Shahrukh Khan, but not directly with him.
sql:
-- Find Shahrukh number 2 actors
WITH SRK_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MID FROM M_Cast WHERE TRIM(PID) = 'nm0451321'
),
co_stars AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) AS PID
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN SRK_movies s ON c.MID = s.MID
    WHERE TRIM(c.PID) != 'nm0451321'
),
srk_actor_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PID) AS PID FROM M_Cast WHERE MID IN (SELECT MID FROM SRK_movies)
),
shahrukh_number_2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c2.PID) AS PID
    FROM M_Cast c2
    JOIN M_Cast c1 ON c2.MID = c1.MID
    WHERE TRIM(c1.PID) IN (SELECT PID FROM co_stars)
    AND TRIM(c2.PID) NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM srk_actor_ids)
    AND TRIM(c2.PID) != 'nm0451321'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shahrukh_number_2

-- Find Shahrukh number 2 actors
WITH SRK_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MID FROM M_Cast WHERE TRIM(PID) = 'nm0451321'
),
co_stars AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) AS PID
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN SRK_movies s ON c.MID = s.MID
    WHERE TRIM(c.PID) != 'nm0451321'
),
srk_actor_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(PID) AS PID FROM M_Cast WHERE MID IN (SELECT MID FROM SRK_movies)
),
shahrukh_number_2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c2.PID) AS PID
    FROM M_Cast c2
    JOIN M_Cast c1 ON c2.MID = c1.MID
    WHERE TRIM(c1.PID) IN (SELECT PID FROM co_stars)
    AND TRIM(c2.PID) NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM srk_actor_ids)
    AND TRIM(c2.PID) != 'nm0451321'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shahrukh_number_2
